primary_variables.matched_definition: Exposure to an exogenous small molecule, inhibitor, activator, toxicant, therapeutic compound, degrader, or vehicle that differentiates experimental groups.
evidence: To study the effect of the decellularization to the hUAs, histological analysis was performed. Then, native and decellularized hUAs were biochemically and biomechanically evaluated. Finally, broad proteomic analysis was applied.

attributes.dose_or_concentration: 8 mM CHAPS, 1 M NaCl, and 25 mM EDTA
evidence: Initially, the hUAs were incubated in a decellularization buffer 1 (DB1), which consisted of 8 mM CHAPS, 1 M NaCl, and 25 mM EDTA in PBS 1× (Gibco, Life Technologies, Grand Island, NY, USA), for 12 h (h) at room temperature (RT).

attributes.dose_or_concentration: 1.8 mM SDS, 1 M NaCl, and 25 mM EDTA
evidence: Then, the hUAs were placed in DB2, consisting of 1.8 mM SDS, 1 M NaCl, and 25 mM EDTA in PBS 1× (Gibco, Life Technologies, Grand Island, NY, USA) for another 12 h at RT

attributes.agent: α-Minimum Essentials Medium (α-ΜΕΜ) with 40% v/v Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS)
evidence: Finally, the hUAs were incubated at 37 °C for 12 h in a α-Minimum Essentials Medium (α-ΜΕΜ, Gibco, Life Technologies, Grand Island, NY, USA) with 40% v/v Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS, Gibco, Life Technologies, Grand Island, NY, USA), ensuring the complete removal of genetic material remnants.

replicate_hints: Native (n = 5) and decellularized (n = 5) hUAs were digested

evidence: Proteomic analysis of hUAs was conducted in order to further evaluate the efficacy of the current decellularization protocol. For this purpose, LC/MS was performed in hUAs before and after the application of the decellularization method.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses LC-MS/MS (Orbitrap-Elite) with a Top 10 precursor selection (DDA) and compares protein abundance between native and decellularized groups without mentioned labels.
